svg.title: Pacific SEC: two regional jet widths
svg.desc: Reported approximate widths: North Vanuatu Jet 300 km; North Caledonian Jet 100 km. Different components from July to October 2005, not annual bounds or whole-current widths.

g.text: Pacific SEC: two regional jet widths
Coral Sea inflow | July-October 2005 campaign | Gourdeau et al. (2008)
Common linear scale: bar length shows the reported approximate width.
Two components, not a 100-300 km seasonal range.
Annual bounds, numerical width uncertainty and exact edge threshold: unknown.
Glider sampling: 0-600 m; neither a fixed-depth width nor full-current thickness.
Source: Gourdeau et al. (2008), doi:10.1175/2007JPO3780.1 | pp.715,722
